title: ADriver-I: A General World Model for Autonomous Driving

output_modality.value: single-view (front) video frames; also predicts ego speed and steer angle as text-like tokens

control_signal.value: ego control signal (speed, steer angle) predicted by the MLLM, turned into a GPT-3.5 motion text prompt, plus historical frames; no boxes or HD map

control_mechanism.value: history frames concatenated with diffusion input (reference-video control); motion text prompt via retained text-condition modules of the video diffusion model

base_model.value: MLLM: Vicuna-7B-1.5 with CLIP-ViT-Large and MLP adapter (LLaVA-7B-1.5 pretrained); video diffusion: Stable Diffusion 2.1 plus temporal modules, trained separately

datasets.value: nuScenes (about 23K video samples for finetuning) and a private highway dataset of nearly 1.4M vision-action pairs

metrics.value: Control prediction: L1 error and threshold accuracy A_theta. Generation: frame-wise FID and FVD.

controllability_evidence.value: Quantitative only for action prediction (L1 0.072 m/s speed, 0.091 rad steer on nuScenes) and FID 5.5 / FVD 97.0 for 4 future frames. Action-to-video effect shown qualitatively (turn left/right).

closed_loop.value: Self-contained recurrent loop (MLLM action then generated frame then action) from three initial pairs, shown only qualitatively; claimed repeatable for infinite steps, no external driving policy or closed-loop metrics.

stated_limitations.value: Generated frames may be low quality when controls change quickly; performance far from deployment level; MLLM and VDM trained separately; no routing or navigation information for long distances.

notes: Output is front-view only. Table 6 compares FID/FVD against DriveGAN and DriveDreamer with different input-output lengths (4F to 4F).
